The Study group [3,7) and Board game night [4,7) overlap in time, so we need to decide how to split or coordinate attendance. Lastly, Scholarship interview [9,10) is strict and requires full attendance. I am open to suggestions on how to best coordinate the overlapping meetings in the 3-7 window.

I would like to check if Jordan can confirm their availability for Gym play and Study group, since those overlap with other meetings I want to attend. Riley and Taylor, can you share your preferences for Lunch break, Music jamming, and Board game night? This will help me optimize overlaps and avoid penalties.

To summarize, my current preference is: Gym play full attendance [0,3), Lunch break full or partial [1,4), Music jamming partial overlapping [2,6), Study group or Board game night but not both fully due to overlap [3,7) and [4,7), and Scholarship interview full attendance [9,10). Please share your views so we can finalize.
